ideas.pitch: An alternative credit scoring platform for smallholder farmers in India combining satellite monitoring data for crop health assessment with transactional history to generate verifiable risk profiles for micro-lenders.
ideas.title: AgriCredit-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting entrepreneurial problem-solving and real-world economic impact in India, this addresses a massive domestic market gap for rural credit validation, appealing directly to industry leaders and judges looking for scalable ventures.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered automated health insurance claim validation agent that reads unstructured hospital discharge summaries and itemized bills to instantly cross-reference policy terms and flag fraudulent claims.
ideas.title: MedClaim-Verify
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical business development value with heavy cost-saving potential for the healthcare industry, aligning with the ideathon's objective to pitch scalable, investor-ready startups.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local micro-internship and skill-matching marketplace connecting Tier-2/3 college students in India with verified local manufacturing MSMEs for short-term engineering and operational projects.
ideas.title: SkillBridge-MSME
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly supports interdisciplinary collaboration and entrepreneurial problem-solving for college students while solving a tangible employability problem for Indian micro-enterprises.

ideas.pitch: An automated ESG and carbon compliance reporting tool for urban SMEs that ingests utility bills and supply chain invoices to calculate emission metrics and suggest cost-effective green transitions.
ideas.title: GreenAudit-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the rising regulatory focus on sustainability and green compliance, giving judges a clear business viability narrative and market validation framework to evaluate.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic delivery route optimization and inventory forecasting web application tailored for hyper-local Kirana delivery networks and dark stores in congested Indian urban centers.
ideas.title: RetailRoute-India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday operational inefficiency in India's booming quick-commerce and retail sector, demonstrating immediate market validation and strong venture scalability to mentor judges.
